fdroid:io.gitlab.maik3531.magnolienotes.name: Magnolie Notes
fdroid:io.gitlab.maik3531.magnolienotes.summary: Local notes and tasks with encrypted sharing to Magnolie Organizer
fdroid:io.gitlab.maik3531.magnolienotes.description:
Magnolie Notes is a local notebook and task list for Android. Organize notes in notebooks, attach images or PDF files, and import text shared by other apps.
Features:
* Notes with creation and modification dates, notebooks and attachments.
* Tasks with due dates, priorities and optional reminders.
* Optional time tracking with scheduled and manual pauses, alarms, encrypted history and monthly printing. Synchronize time records with your own Organizer after both devices opt in; local Notes removals do not delete Organizer records. Region and holidays are inherited from Organizer.
* Import shared text and supported exported note files.
* Local encrypted storage and user-controlled backups.
* Optional encrypted sharing with paired Magnolie Organizer installations on Linux and Windows.
* Twenty interface languages.
No account or cloud service is required to use the notebook. Magnolie Organizer is a separate, free desktop application.
Optional connections and permissions:
* Discover Organizer or Magnolienbaum devices on the local network using UDP broadcast and Android network service discovery (NSD/mDNS). Discovery announces connection details; it does not authorize another device to read your notes. Pairing requires confirmation.
* Share and synchronize selected notes and tasks with paired devices over encrypted connections. Bluetooth/RFCOMM can be enabled as a data fallback when the operating system and the paired devices support it; automatic Personal Sync remains Wi-Fi-only.
* Allow a paired desktop to request outgoing calls on this phone, show incoming-call information, and request answering or ending a call. These actions depend on Android permissions and system restrictions. Call-related permissions include phone state, phone-number access and, where Android requires it for caller identification, call-log access.
* Read Android contacts and their available photos, import reviewed contact cards, or synchronize contacts with a permitted branch. Contact writing needs its own Android permission. Read-only desktop access does not write phone contacts.
* Optionally mirror the titles and text of notifications from apps you choose to the paired desktop. This requires enabling Magnolie Notes in Android’s notification-access settings and selecting the apps to share; it does not grant unrestricted access to those apps’ private data.
* Optional time-tracking autostart can detect a selected visible Wi-Fi SSID without connecting or logging in. Android requires precise location permission and location services for these scans. Notes reads Wi-Fi observations, not GPS coordinates. An ongoing notification shows monitoring; Android may delay scans. Open the app after a device restart to resume monitoring.
* A permitted own desktop can read, start, pause, resume or end local timers when time tracking is enabled. Developer options can separately allow redacted technical connection and crash diagnostics over the confirmed own Wi-Fi link.
These integrations are opt-in through pairing, feature choices and the relevant Android permission or access prompts. They are not required for local note-taking. You can disable a feature, revoke its permission or remove a paired device. Bluetooth data transport is separate from any system-managed hands-free call-audio connection. Magnolie Notes does not provide native SMS or RCS messaging.
Version information: Opening the About page requests public release information from GitHub and compares the published Notes version locally. No note content or account credentials are sent. A release link opens your browser; Notes does not download or install APK updates itself.

flathub:net.sourceforge.quakespasm.Quake.description:
Quakespasm is a *Nix friendly Quake Engine based on the SDL port of the popular FitzQuake.
 It includes some new features, important fixes, and aims for portability and 64 bit correctness.
 Features:
 Supports Windows, Mac OS X, Linux, other unices.
 Well tested on both 32 bit and 64 bit platforms.
 Well tested on both little endian and big endian platforms.
 OpenGL improvements. In-game resolution changing.
 Widescreen FOV (field of view) support and automatic Hor+ FOV scaling.
 Improved sound support. Support for OGG, MP3, Opus and WAV external music files.
 Improved game controller support using SDL2.
 Countless bug fixes, security fixes and other improvements.
 Support for playing the 'Quake 2021 re-release' content

 pak0.pak. In order to set this up, open (and if necessary create) the directory
 ~/.var/app/net.sourceforge.quakespasm.Quakespasm/data on your computer and copy the id1 directory
 from a copy of Quake there. Quakespasm will notify you on startup if it cannot find or access the game data.

firefox-addons:2934963.name: Canvas Privacy Protection
firefox-addons:2934963.summary: Prevents Canvas LMS from tracking page visibility and warns about Google tracking analytics
firefox-addons:2934963.description:
Tired of unfair academic integrity accusations based on faulty Canvas quiz logs? Many instructors misinterpret Canvas's official data, leading to honest students being falsely accused of cheating just for switching tabs or minimizing a window.
Canvas Privacy Protection is your shield against these misleading metrics. This extension overrides Canvas's page visibility detection by making your browser always appear focused and visible to the website. It blocks the specific event listeners that detect when you leave a website, minimize the page, or lose focus, ensuring the page always reports itself as "visible" and "focused." This means:
No more false "tab-switching" logs: Your browser will always appear to be actively focused on Canvas, preventing misinterpretations of legitimate study habits, interference from browser tab offloading, notifications, bathroom breaks, and more.
Protection against flawed data: We ensure your Canvas experience aligns with Canvas's own documentation, which states that "Quiz logs should not be used to validate academic integrity or identify occurrences of cheating."
What this extension does NOT do:
It does not interfere with other Canvas functionality or logging.
It does not provide any unfair academic advantage.
Instructors can still see essential data like your IP address, device identifiers, and how long you spend on each question.
Enhanced Privacy Beyond Canvas
We go a step further! This extension also provides crucial guidance to protect your privacy on Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides. Did you know document owners can see your view history on enterprise Google accounts? This feature has also been misused to falsely accuse students.
We'll guide you through simple, manual steps to disable these Google view history settings, helping you maintain your privacy. Our extension will even alert you with a warning banner if you view Google documents before you've disabled these settings, ensuring you're always protected.
Additionally, we allow users to set the extension to run on any page they want by making those sites also always appear focused. There are many use cases for wanting to make a website think you are focused such as preventing session timeouts, ensuring continuous live updates on dashboards or news feeds, avoiding automatic video or audio pauses when switching tabs, and maintaining optimal performance for complex web applications or browser-based games.
For maximal privacy, we always recommend saving all course materials locally! Canvas even has an export course feature to help you do this.
Install Canvas Privacy Protection today and take control of your academic privacy!
Educational and Privacy Purpose Only!
This extension is designed solely to protect user privacy and prevent misinterpretation of flawed tracking data. It is NOT intended to circumvent academic integrity measures or violate any institutional policies.

No Circumvention Intent
This extension addresses Canvas's own documented position that "Quiz logs should not be used to validate academic integrity or identify occurrences of cheating." It is designed to prevent false accusations based on unreliable data, not to enable any form of academic dishonesty. We encourage instructors to use Canvas's built in features such as LockDown Browser®, and/or external proctoring tools such as Proctorio®.
No Warranty or Liability

firefox-addons:2932863.name: PubNL Translator
firefox-addons:2932863.summary: Replaces subtitles on NPO videos with auto-translated subtitles.
firefox-addons:2932863.description:
PubNL Translator allows you to watch content by NPO with subtitles in a language other than Dutch. Subtitles are translated using Google Translate and can be translated to any language it supports.
 How to use PubNL Translator 
After installing, start watching any video on an NPO website. Make sure to enable the subtitles. PubNL Translator will automatically translate the subtitles and replace them in the video.
By default, PubNL Translator will translate subtitles into English, but this can be changed to any language that Google Translate supports.
For more information, check out the GitHub page of PubNL Translator .

Getting links to download videos from Youtube and other sites containing a youtube player in 3GP and MP4 formats and resolutions from 144p to 720p.
 Ability to download only videos without audio content (144 p2K) encoded in MP4 or WEBM format
 You can also download the audio track separately (MP4, VORBIS, OPUS)
 Save the preview in JPEG format with a width of 90 to 720 pixels
 NEW! Download video subtitles (if available) in HTML format and UTF-8 encoding (only in the online version)

firefox-addons:3125766.name: AI Verdict — shopping assistant
firefox-addons:3125766.summary: Pinduoduo in your language: translated pages, prices in your currency and an AI check of a product before you buy.
firefox-addons:3125766.description:
AI Verdict helps people outside China shop on Pinduoduo ( mobile.pinduoduo.com ) — in Firefox on a computer and in Firefox for Android.
• Pinduoduo in your language — product titles, buttons, filters and image badges are translated into 24 languages.
• Prices in your currency — next to the yuan price you see the amount in any of 44 currencies at a fresh exchange rate.
• An AI verdict before you pay — the AI reads the title, every variant with its price, the specs, the description images and the reviews, and answers specific questions: is the low price for a cheap bait variant, what is in the small print, what buyers complain about, who the seller is and what matters for shipping abroad. You get a clear verdict on a “buy or skip” scale and ready-made questions for the seller in Chinese.
• Search helper — describe what you need in your own words and get search queries in Chinese.
• Favorites — save items together with their analysis.
How it works
1. Install the extension and sign in with a one-time code sent to your email. New accounts get 60 free credits.
2. Open a product on mobile.pinduoduo.com .
3. Press the analysis button at the bottom of the product page and choose a check. The verdict appears under the buy button.
The AI Verdict panel opens from the extension icon (on Android: menu → Extensions → AI Verdict) or from the “V” button on the page.
Pricing
Translation and prices are free within a daily limit. AI checks are paid with credits: a Quick check costs 1 credit, Essentials 48, Full 180, Deep 835. Credit packs: 1,500 credits for $3, 3,300 for $6, 7,000 for $12. Payments are processed by Paddle on aiverdict.link.
Privacy
AI Verdict works only on the Pinduoduo pages you open yourself. It does not sign in to your Pinduoduo account, press buttons or place orders. Product data is sent for analysis only when you start a check. Details: https://aiverdict.link/privacy.html 
AI Verdict is an independent service and is not affiliated with PDD Holdings or Pinduoduo.

apple-macos:1668083311.name: Whisper Transcription
apple-macos:1668083311.description:
Transcrivez rapidement et facilement vos fichiers audio en texte grâce à la technologie de transcription de pointe Whisper. Transcrivez des fichiers depuis d'autres applications via l'extension de partage et obtenez des transcriptions de haute qualité en quelques secondes.
■ Fonctionnalités
- Partagez des fichiers audio et des mémos vocaux depuis des applications telles qu'iMessage, WhatsApp et Dictaphone pour les transcrire
- Enregistrez directement dans l'application et lancez la transcription ensuite
- Transcrivez avec une qualité optimale et une vitesse maximale grâce à la transcription cloud Assistant
- Transcrivez localement sur votre appareil grâce à un modèle embarqué téléchargeable pour une utilisation hors ligne et pour vos fichiers audio confidentiels (iPhone 13 ou plus récent, ou iPad avec puce série M requis)
- Obtenez des résumés IA de haute qualité
- Discutez avec vos transcriptions pour extraire rapidement les informations utiles d'un long enregistrement
- Sélectionnez la langue de transcription (ou utilisez la détection automatique)
- Formats pris en charge : mp3, wav, m4a, mp4, mov
■ Langues prises en charge
Whisper Transcription peut transcrire l'audio dans 100 langues différentes :
anglais, chinois, allemand, espagnol, russe, coréen, français, japonais, ... (liste complète de 100 langues)
Les abonnements se renouvellent automatiquement, sauf si le renouvellement automatique est désactivé au moins 24 heures avant la fin de la période en cours, et le montant sera débité de votre compte iTunes. Vous pouvez désactiver le renouvellement automatique et gérer vos abonnements dans les réglages de votre compte iTunes après l'achat. Conditions d'utilisation : https://www.macwhisper.com/legal/terms | Politique de confidentialité : https://www.macwhisper.com/legal/privacy-policy

apple-itunes:1467720176.description:
AI health coach for lasting weight loss
Simple helps you lose weight with personalized plans, real-time nutrition analysis, on-demand coaching, and tailored workouts—without calorie counting or extreme restrictions. 
For the first time, progress actually feels fun. Think of us as the Duolingo of health: motivating, enjoyable, and surprisingly delightful. While other solutions push extremes, Simple helps you find a balance that keeps you smiling throughout your weight loss journey. Consistency, made easy.
What you get with Simple
An AI coach trained by experts
Avo™ is your smart in-app coach, guiding you with personalized advice, motivational coaching, and science-backed strategies—anytime, anywhere.
Instant food feedback with Avo Vision
Snap a photo of your groceries, menu, or meal and get instant guidance, nutrition insights, and recipe ideas. No calorie math—just clear, actionable advice on the go.
Easy, personalized workouts
Get simple, beginner-friendly workout plans designed to match your fitness level and goals. Build strength, burn calories, and stay consistent with exercise routines you’ll actually enjoy.
A real-time Success Score, designed to keep you on track
Track progress in real time with your personalized Success Score. Instantly see how your choices stack up, understand where to adjust, and stay motivated as you move closer to your goals.
Sustainable results without the stress
Turn small daily choices into lasting habits so you can lose weight, feel better, and stay consistent without rigid dieting.
Meet Blinky: your emotional support fluff
Most weight loss apps give you charts and streaks. Simple gives you Blinky.
He’s playful, dramatic, and impossible to ignore. Log a salad, he cheers. Log late-night fries, he’ll indulge with you while helping you get back on track. Skip logging, and he sulks—or goes full chaos.
Blinky makes consistency fun:
- Daily motivation—“What will Blinky say today?”
- Playful accountability—reactions that keep you logging.
- Streak rewards—stay consistent and earn golden Blinky.
It’s accountability without the scolding. His moods keep you engaged, entertained, and coming back—making healthy habits stick and driving real weight loss.
Features you’ll love
- Personalized weight loss coaching from Avo™
- Photo-based nutrition feedback with Avo Vision
- Beginner-friendly, personalized workout plans
- Honest, playful motivation from Blinky
- Quick food, water, activity, and weight logging
- iOS Home Screen widget & Apple Health + Watch integration
Why Simple works
Weight loss isn’t about perfection—it’s about consistency. Simple makes logging easy, workouts approachable, and healthy choices fun, so you can build habits that last.
That’s why people call us the “Duolingo of Health.” We turn hard work into something enjoyable, motivating, and even delightful. Where other apps feel clinical or restrictive, Simple keeps you smiling, laughing, and coming back for more.
And it works. To date, Simple serves 800,000+ active subscribers, who have collectively lost more than 17.5 million pounds. With 20M+ downloads and an average 4.7-star rating, Simple ranks among the world’s top-rated wellness apps.
We’ve also been recognized globally—named among the Top 100 AI Companies by the World Future Awards (2025) and awarded Best Virtual Health Coach by MedTech Breakthrough (2025). Our methods are backed by science, published in peer-reviewed journals, and presented at leading international conferences.
For further information, please visit https://support.apple.com/en-gb/HT202039.
